# Find exact pot bottom contact
from PIL import Image
import numpy as np
img = np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/obs_0027.png'))
pot_contacts = []
for c in range(91, 134):
    for r in range(380, 340, -1):
        if img[r, c, 0] > 70 and img[r, c, 1] < 100 and img[r, c, 2] < 50:
            pot_contacts.append((c, r))
            break
print('Pot contacts:', len(pot_contacts))
print('Left edge:', pot_contacts[0])
print('Right edge:', pot_contacts[-1])
max_r = max(p[1] for p in pot_contacts)
print('Lowest row:', max_r)
for p in pot_contacts:
    if p[1] == max_r:
        print('Lowest pt:', p)
"
